name: DIAGNOSTIC fast
notes: NOT A SOLDERING PROFILE. Peaks at 95 C and exercises preheat, soak, a liquidus crossing, peak, cooldown, report, every screen, the chart and the console commands in a couple of minutes. liquidus_c is 80 C purely so the run crosses it; that number means nothing metallurgical, and the 10-400 s window on time above liquidus is wide because what it actually measures is how long the room takes to cool the oven back through 80 C after the run ends, which is not a property of this profile. Melts no solder and reflows nothing. It does apply real heat: 95 C is hot enough to matter to anything left inside, and hot enough that the oven is well over the 45 C pre-flight limit when the run ends, so back-to-back iterations wait for a real cooldown. Starts at 45 C so that preheat has work to do -- the shipped pastes all start at room temperature, where preheat is a no-op, and this is the only profile that exercises it.
reference: not a paste; a fixture for exercising the firmware
